The repeated formulations are concrete and material, not merely generic resignation-letter conventions. C12 and C15 are weaker comparators because they share the resignation-and-commendation form but concern different offices and have fewer distinctive parallels.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"accept your proffered resignation as Secretary of Defense, effective at the close of business on September 19, 1950","parent_excerpt":"I accept your resignation effective at the close of business on March thirty-first","explanation":"Nearly identical operative acceptance language and effective-time formula, with C07 involving the same office."},{"child_excerpt":"The manner in which you have carried out the purposes of the National Security Act testifies to your high administrative skill ...
